title: Share a checked low-level component across actual consumers
obstacle: Several proof nodes separately reconstruct a scan, encoding, state update or connection that has the same observable contract.
procedure: Inspect what the consumers actually need and look for a compatible checked component in the pinned library.
If useful, isolate the operation behind a small proved interface covering its output, relevant state and resource effects.
Instantiate that same interface at the consuming sites and verify the original obligations there.
verification: Check which consumer obligations the component discharges and whether its representation and costs preserve the requested guarantees.
positive_example: Multiple traversals reuse the same certified array-scan specification when their preconditions and charging model agree.
negative_example: Introducing helpers that assume the missing implementation, or forget a cost needed by a caller, only moves the obligation.

evidence.note: General design guidance. Check its conditions in the current argument; no comparative performance claim.
